verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence touching documentation is that Postman's Agent Mode can "write documentation," which is a thin form of generation. Nothing shows documentation generated directly from collections or specs, or a way to publish it; the Public API Network line about publishers sharing APIs is adjacent and not documentation publishing. missing for 10: documented doc generation from collections/specs, documentation publishing/hosting workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can generate and publish API documentation from my collections or specs

citations.quote: You can ask Agent Mode to add tests to requests, visualize responses, write documentation, and more.
